title: Tree path support lies in the available set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type of output labels, and let a binary decision tree on $n$ coordinates query only coordinates in its available set, removing each queried coordinate from the set available to its children. Every coordinate specified by a path in the tree's generated path list belongs to the tree's available set.
hypotheses_covered: The tree is a binary decision tree on $n$ coordinates with labels in $\alpha$
The tree is indexed by an available set of coordinates
The path belongs to the tree's generated path list
